title: Home Purchase Financing Contract — Payoff and Lien Release Clause
content:
**Payoff and lien release clause — Home Purchase Financing retail installment contract**

1. **Open loans only.** A payoff statement is issued only on a loan that is active or delinquent, as the company's record of that loan shows; the same holds for a payoff payment.
2. **Issue, fee and good-through — retired clause.** *"It is issued within the program's statement business days of the request at a fee of the program's payoff statement fee, and its figure is good through the program's good-through days in calendar days after the statement date." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as a record.*
3. **Payoff amount — retired clause.** *"The payoff amount is the unpaid principal, plus interest at the note rate on the unpaid principal for each day from the due date of the last installment paid through the good-through date on the program's day basis, plus fees owed, less suspense funds; the escrow balance is not netted and is refunded separately after payoff." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as a record.*
4. **No penalty.** There is no prepayment penalty.
5. **Receipt of the payoff.** A payoff received on or before the good-through date in at least the stated amount pays the loan off; a smaller amount, or one received after the good-through date, is applied as an ordinary payment and the loan stays open until a new statement is satisfied.
6. **Lien release.** The lien on the home's title is released within the program's lien-release days in calendar days after payoff.

### Receipt outcomes (hypothetical statement: 41000.00 good through 2026-05-19)

| Amount received | Date received | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 41000.00 | 2026-05-19 | pays the loan off |
| 41050.00 | 2026-05-12 | pays the loan off |
| 40990.00 | 2026-05-15 | applied as an ordinary payment; the loan stays open |
| 41000.00 | 2026-05-20 | applied as an ordinary payment; the loan stays open |
